items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: And Joe was a player like me. So we would switch off and then we’d all switch off. When we played shows none of us played strictly lead...

ctx.x: That was the summer section. And it was great because I was sort of the lead trumpet at the time. And I’d say, “Al, you’ve got to play this one. This one is — we’re only going to do it twice” I said, “we want to get a good recording for this guy,” I said, “I might mess this funny technique place up.” You know? “Oh, okay.” And he’d just kill it. I mean you could turn the music upside down and he could read it. Allen Vizutti could play, because he played the way I’m talking about only his mind was like ten times…
